items.title: Cardiac Myosin Activation with Omecamtiv Mecarbil in Systolic Heart Failure.
items.journal: The New England journal of medicine
items.summary: Omecamtiv mecarbil, a cardiac myosin activator, failed to significantly reduce cardiovascular death or heart failure events in patients with HFrEF in the GALACTIC-HF trial.

items.title: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction: everything the clinician needs to know.
items.summary: Comprehensive review of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction covering pathophysiology, diagnosis, and management challenges.

items.title: Phenotype-Specific Treatment of Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction: A Multiorgan Roadmap.
items.summary: Proposes phenotype-specific treatment strategies for HFpEF addressing the failure of neurohumoral inhibition trials and phenotypic diversity.

items.title: Pathophysiology and Therapeutic Approaches to Acute Decompensated Heart Failure.
items.summary: Reviews pathophysiology and therapeutic approaches to acute decompensated heart failure, highlighting limited treatment options.

items.title: Withdrawal of pharmacological treatment for heart failure in patients with recovered dilated cardiomyopathy (TRED-HF): an open-label, pilot, randomised trial.
items.summary: TRED-HF trial showed that withdrawing heart failure medications in patients with recovered dilated cardiomyopathy led to relapse in 44% of patients.

items.title: Withdrawal of heart failure therapy after atrial fibrillation rhythm control with ejection fraction normalization: the WITHDRAW-AF trial.
items.summary: WITHDRAW-AF trial demonstrated that early withdrawal of heart failure therapy after atrial fibrillation rhythm control increased risk of LVEF decline.

items.title: Consequences of Discontinuing Long-Term Drug Treatment in Patients With Heart Failure and Reduced Ejection Fraction.
items.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
items.summary: Reviews consequences of discontinuing long-term heart failure drug treatment, showing clinical worsening patterns after withdrawal.

items.title: Current and future therapeutic perspective in chronic heart failure.
items.summary: Reviews current and future therapeutic perspectives in chronic heart failure, noting lack of established treatments for HFpEF and HFmrEF.

items.title: 'Time is prognosis' in heart failure: time-to-treatment initiation as a modifiable risk factor.
items.summary: Emphasizes the importance of timely treatment initiation in acute heart failure as a modifiable prognostic factor.

items.title: Dapagliflozin Effects on Biomarkers, Symptoms, and Functional Status in Patients With Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction: The DEFINE-HF Trial.
items.summary: DEFINE-HF trial showed dapagliflozin improved symptoms and biomarkers in patients with HFrEF, supporting SGLT2 inhibitor benefits.

items.title: Blinded Withdrawal of Long-Term Randomized Treatment With Empagliflozin or Placebo in Patients With Heart Failure.

canonicalFacts.claim: Withdrawal of heart failure medications in patients with recovered function leads to high relapse rates

excludedAgents.name: Omecamtiv mecarbil
excludedAgents.reason: Failed to significantly reduce the primary composite endpoint of cardiovascular death or heart failure events in the GALACTIC-HF randomized trial of 8,256 patients with HFrEF
